posts.author: rjh102104
posts.body:
Hi I'm trying to make a video and this is making me mad. So what I'm trying to do is have the character keep getting a weapon thats stronger and stronger throughout the battle. In the "Battle test" Function in the database, this works fine. But coming to the battle through the actual game, it doesnt. It does 0 damage. (the 999 attack is me desperately trying to get it to do something.) I did record a video of this in action but it wont let me upload videos on here. i do have a few scripts in too but i wouldnt imagine it would make the damage work in the battle test but not the real battle. Idk how this is even possible. Pls help.
also unrelated but would be neat: how would i go about removing the "mp:0" from riley but keep mp visible on noelle. little quality of life thing

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body:
Little bit of a guess on my part, since I'm not too familiar with the ancient engines, but I see in your event you're not actually giving the player the weapon. Equip weapon can only work when said weapon is in the player's inventory (That's the case on MV/MZ, so my guess is it's the same in XP).
Try adding the weapon to the inventory, then equipping it.

posts.author: kyonides
posts.body: If you deal 0 damage in XP, it means your actor has no weapon equipped.
